record_type_quote:
In this study we tried to replicate the unconscious
thought advantage (UTA), which states that complex decisions are
better handled by unconscious thinking.

targets.title: Think different: the merits of unconscious thought in preference development and decision making.
targets.evidence_quote:
Our main aim was to construct the same task as was
typically used in UTT paradigms and replicate findings of
Dijksterhuis and his colleagues [1]-[3].
targets.outcome_quote:
In conclusion, we did not replicate the results suggested by
UTT. However, from the present study we cannot conclude
whether this was the case of flaws in the theory or flaws in our
experiment.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly conclude that they did not replicate UTA. They consider possible theoretical or experimental explanations, but do not state that this attempt cannot adjudicate the claim.

reasoning: Completed new-sample test of UTA. Reference [2] is the primary empirical original; [1] is a theory paper and [3] a meta-analysis, which inform the design but are not independently re-tested originals. Earlier failures and other supportive studies are literature context. Title and both authors agree with the assignment; OpenAlex links the assigned ResearchGate DOI to this Zenodo copy.
